table_title: Which sovereign states currently drive on the left side of the road, with their continent and population?
db_analog: SELECT country, continent, population FROM sovereign_states WHERE driving_side = 'left' ORDER BY country
temporal_note: Wikidata SPARQL endpoint snapshot, accessed 2026-06-08. Universe is the set of sovereign states (P31 = Q3624078) that currently use left-hand traffic, defined as having at least one P1622 (driving side) statement equal to Q11920728 (left-hand traffic) that is not marked deprecated and that has no end-time qualifier (pq:P582). The end-time filter is load-bearing: it excludes Argentina (which switched to right-hand traffic on 1945-06-10 but whose pre-1945 left-hand-traffic statement is at normal rank in Wikidata), Sweden (Dagen H, 1967-09-03), Iceland (H Day, 1968-05-26), and Czechoslovakia (no longer extant; right-hand traffic adopted 1939-1941). Driving-side conventions are stable on a once-per-generation timescale; the most recent reversal of any sovereign state was Samoa (2009, right-to-left). Population values are Wikidata's most-recent P1082 statement per country and update on a yearly cadence; the row set is otherwise stable.
_extraction_notes: Verbatim seed #2 from datasets/pkdb_bench/docs/example_questions.txt ('Which countries drive on the left side of the road?'). Source plan: Tier A — Wikidata SPARQL endpoint, source_count = 1. The canonical SPARQL is at datasets/build_benchmark/sparql_queries/countries_drive_on_left.sparql; running it via datasets/build_benchmark/sparql_to_csv.py with --rename '{"country":"Country","continent":"Continent","population":"Population"}' on 2026-06-08 returns 57 raw bindings. The 57-to-54 reduction is a documented post-processing step that collapses the three Pacific island states (Kiribati, Solomon Islands, Tuvalu) whose P30 (continent) field on Wikidata carries both 'Oceania' (Q538) and 'Insular Oceania' (Q55643) values into a single canonical 'Oceania' continent label per row. The continent disambiguation rule is: if a country has a P30 = Oceania value, use 'Oceania'; otherwise if it has only a P30 = Insular Oceania value, also map to 'Oceania' for cross-row consistency (Fiji is the only country with this shape in the result set). All other continents have at most one P30 value per country and need no post-processing. SPARQL design: §1 of references/sparql-gotchas.md applies — the universe-membership clause uses the all-ranks property path 'p:P1622/ps:P1622' rather than the truthy 'wdt:P1622' shortcut, because some countries have multiple historical P1622 statements (Argentina pre-1945, Sweden pre-Dagen-H, Iceland pre-H-Day) that should be filtered out by their pq:P582 end-time qualifier rather than by relying on rank curation alone. Without the end-time filter, the truthy path returns Argentina (whose P1622 = right-hand traffic and P1622 = left-hand traffic statements are both at normal rank, so the truthy path returns both); with the end-time filter, only currently-active 'left-hand traffic' statements are kept. Sovereignty is enforced via wdt:P31 wd:Q3624078, which excludes British Overseas Territories (Anguilla, Bermuda, BVI, Cayman, Falkland, Montserrat, Pitcairn, Saint Helena, Turks and Caicos), Crown Dependencies (Guernsey, Isle of Man, Jersey, Sark), associated states (Cook Islands, Niue), other dependencies (Hong Kong, Macau, US Virgin Islands, Christmas Island, Cocos Islands, Norfolk Island, Tokelau, Pitcairn, Saint Helena/Ascension/Tristan da Cunha), historical countries (Czechoslovakia, Dominion of Newfoundland, British Hong Kong), and non-state entities accidentally tagged with P1622 (the European Union, Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge, Yungas Road, A1 road, Trolleybuses in Kathmandu, Ikarus 281 bus model, individual people, provinces, cities, etc.). Result: 54 rows x 3 columns, PK on Country, 0 duplicates. Continent distribution: Africa 14, Asia 14, North America 10, Oceania 10, Europe 4, South America 2. Population values are Wikidata's most-recent P1082 statement per country in the 2026-06-08 endpoint snapshot; India uses preferred-rank P1082 1326093247 at point-in-time 2020-07-01.
